# Completed Project Record — Emirate Digital Services Programme

Customer: Emirate Digital Services Authority, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
Engagement: Web application and API penetration testing.
Scope delivered: 22 web applications and 9 application programming interfaces.
Contract period: 6 January 2025 to 28 March 2025.
Contract value band: government framework, disclosed on request.
Delivery team: Ahmed Hassan (Lead Tester), Zain Malik (Senior Tester).
Completion certificate issued: 11 April 2025.

## Customer reference

The Authority has confirmed in writing that it will act as a reference for this
engagement. Reference contact: Head of Information Security, Emirate Digital
Services Authority, confirmed current on 2 February 2026.

Written statement from the customer, dated 11 April 2025:

"Cybranytech completed the assessment within the agreed schedule and provided
clear, reproducible findings with practical remediation advice. The retesting
phase confirmed that all critical and high findings had been resolved."
